name: Identify an obligation in an agreement
short_description: Identify an obligation in an agreement once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can identify an obligation in an agreement in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Identify an obligation in an agreement means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Identify an obligation in an agreement in a fresh real-life scenario.
